user.title: Danfoss Ally (Cloud)
user.description: Sign in with your Danfoss Ally / Smart Life app account. No developer app or API key is required. The installation secrets (sign key, device id, channel key) are captured once on the installation (see the documentation).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again to Danfoss Ally (Cloud)
reauth_confirm.description: The Danfoss Ally account refused the sign-in (password changed, or installation secrets no longer valid). Enter the password of the same account. Fill in the sign key, device id or channel key only if they changed: left empty, the current value is kept.

data.sign_key: Sign key (sign_key) — only if it changed
data.device_id: Device id (deviceId) — only if it changed
data.ch_key: Channel key (chKey) — only if it changed

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Danfoss Ally (Cloud)
reconfigure.description: Update the country code, datacenter, password or installation secrets. Leave any secret field empty to keep the current value.

data.sign_key: Sign key (sign_key) — only if it changed
data.device_id: Device id (deviceId) — only if it changed
data.ch_key: Channel key (chKey) — only if it changed

abort.wrong_account: This is not the account of this entry: sign in with the same account, or add the other account as a new entry

data.distinct_device_id: Use a dedicated device id (coexist with the Danfoss app / MCP connector without logging each other out)
data.enable_local: Enable the local Zigbee tunnel (gateways) for writes the cloud misses
data.local_supervised_settings: Supervised trial — head settings written through the LOCAL TUNNEL, NOT yet validated on real hardware, opened for a first write done in person on a test head (see docs/tunnel-settings-trial.md). Needs the local tunnel. Leave empty otherwise
data.local_supervised_head: Supervised trial — the ONE test head the local-tunnel settings ticked above open on. Every other head gets no write entity. Leave on — when no trial is running: nothing is then open
data.post_command_refresh: Refresh just-commanded heads via the per-device route (R-3: the bulk poll lags for minutes after a change). Off by default — turn on for a real-hardware validation session
data.enable_vacation_write: Enable vacation writes (holiday set/cancel). Off by default — turn on only for a supervised real-hardware validation
data.enable_head_unbind: Enable device unbind (disconnect a head, sensor or relay from the network). Destructive — off by default; turn on only for a supervised real-hardware validation
data.enable_cloud_mqtt: Enable the Tuya cloud MQTT channel (experimental, unofficial): writes the settings of a head that is in no room. Off by default — keeps a connection open to the Tuya broker on your account
data.cloud_mqtt_supervised_dps: Supervised trial — settings NOT yet validated on the Tuya cloud MQTT channel, opened for a first write done in person on a test head (see docs/first-write-procedure.md). Leave empty otherwise
data.cloud_mqtt_supervised_head: Supervised trial — the ONE test head the settings ticked above open on (an isolated head). Every other head keeps its normal routing. Leave on — when no trial is running: nothing is then open
data.cloud_mqtt_probe: Measure what the Tuya cloud MQTT broker pushes (listen-only, nothing is sent to the heads; aggregates in the diagnostics). Off by default — opens a broker connection on your account, closes itself after 48 h
data.mqtt_mode: MQTT publishing: off, discovery (auto HA entities), zigbee2mqtt (z2m-compatible topics)
data.mqtt_source: Source of published values: cloud or local

rooms.name: Rooms

set_override.name: Set temperature override

target.name: Head

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Override temperature in degrees C (5 to 35, by 0.5).

clear_override.name: Clear temperature override
clear_override.description: End an override by re-applying the setpoint the schedule prescribes now.

target.name: Head
target.description: Target head: type device and its device id (see the service example).

set_window_detection.name: Set window detection (local)
set_window_detection.description: Write a head's open-window detection over the local Zigbee tunnel (isolated heads of a verified product).

target.name: Head

enabled.name: Enabled

get_schedule.name: Get schedule

target.name: Target
target.description: Target: type 'room' or 'device', and its id.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Re-read from the cloud instead of the cache.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes the given days of a target (validated first). Admin only.

target.name: Target
target.description: Target: type 'room' or 'device', and its id.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to write: each day holds its ranges (start and end times).

copy_schedule.name: Copy schedule
copy_schedule.description: Copies one target's schedule onto others. Admin only.

restore_schedule.name: Restore schedule
restore_schedule.description: Rewrites the schedule then publishes at_home (R4). Admin only.

target.name: Target
target.description: Target: type 'room' or 'device', and its id.

get_write_job.name: Write job status
get_write_job.description: Follows a write job by its id.

get_room.name: Get room
get_room.description: One room's detail and its weekly schedule.

create_room.name: Create room
create_room.description: Create a room and attach the given heads. Admin; real-hardware validation required.

devices.name: Heads
devices.description: List of head devIds to attach (verified products).

home.name: Home
home.description: Optional home gid to create the room in. If omitted, inferred from the devices (all must share one home).

delete_room.name: Delete room
delete_room.description: Delete a room; its heads become ungrouped. Admin; real-hardware validation required.

set_relay_room.name: Set relay room
set_relay_room.description: Link or unlink a room to the boiler relay (its heat demand drives the relay). Admin; real-hardware validation required.

linked.name: Linked
linked.description: On = the room drives the relay; off = unlink.

get_relays.name: Get boiler relays
get_relays.description: Boiler relays and the rooms driving them (read only).

get_overview.name: Get fleet overview
get_overview.description: Building / fleet overview across homes, gateways and rooms (read only).

attach_heads.name: Attach heads
attach_heads.description: Add heads to a room (replaces the member list). Admin.

detach_heads.name: Detach heads
detach_heads.description: Remove heads from a room (cannot empty it). Admin.

disconnect_head.name: Disconnect (unbind) device
disconnect_head.description: Unbind a sub-device (head, sensor or relay) from the network (the app's "disconnect"). A gateway is refused. DESTRUCTIVE: the device leaves the network and disappears from the account; re-pairing needs a physical action on site. Off by default — enable head unbind in the options. Admin.

target.name: Target
target.description: Target: type 'device' and the sub-device's devId (head, sensor or relay; not a gateway).

wipe_data.name: Wipe data (factory reset)
wipe_data.description: Off = disconnect (identity kept; same devId on re-pairing). On = disconnect and wipe data (factory reset: new devId, identity and name lost — IRREVERSIBLE).

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on: guard against an accidental destructive call.

too_many_transitions.message: Too many ranges: at most three separate ranges (6 transitions) per day.

head_not_following_schedule.message: Isolated head not following a schedule (offline, manual mode or no active schedule): the schedule write is refused.

isolated_restore_unproven.message: Back to schedule has no proven route for an isolated head: use the Danfoss app.

local_disabled.message: The local tunnel is not enabled on this account.

device_only.message: This local-tunnel action targets a head (type 'device').

unverified_product.message: Writing is not verified for this product.

local_unreachable.message: The head is not reachable through the local tunnel.

local_write_failed.message: The local-tunnel write was refused by the head.

invalid_day.message: Unknown day (expected mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat or sun).

invalid_setpoint.message: Setpoint out of range (5 to 35 degrees C, by 0.5).

no_schedule.message: No schedule to return to; the override lapses at the next scheduled change.

no_members_left.message: Detaching every head would empty the room: use delete_room.

unknown_home.message: None of the given heads were found in any home.

ambiguous_home.message: The given heads are in different homes; create one room per home.

vacation_disabled.message: Vacation writes are disabled; enable them in the integration options (for a real-hardware validation session).

unbind_disabled.message: Head unbind is disabled; enable it in the integration options (for a supervised real-hardware validation session).

confirmation_required.message: Destructive action: set confirm to true to unbind this device.

gateway_target.message: Refused: this is a gateway — unbinding it would drop all its heads. Target a sub-device (head, sensor or relay).

invalid_vacation_period.message: Invalid vacation period: the end must be after the start.

empty_rooms.message: This home has no room for a vacation.

at_home_no_saturday.message: The "at home" option makes heads follow the Saturday schedule, but no targeted room has a Saturday slot. Add a Saturday slot, or use a fixed setpoint (away).

gateway_offline.description: Gateway **{name}** is reported offline by the Danfoss cloud. Heads paired to it cannot be reached until the gateway reconnects.

head_fault.title: Danfoss Ally hardware fault on {name}
head_fault.description: Radiator thermostat **{name}** reports active fault(s): **{faults}**. Inspect the valve mounting, battery or pin on site.
